release: Compass CPU v2 public repository layout
repackaging_changes: Moved selected checkpoint to Hugging Face repository root.
Replaced the private selected-checkpoint path with a human-readable lineage identifier.
Added recorded base asset hashes to enforce pinned-base verification in inference.
Delayed heavyweight imports for lightweight import/help checks and added a CPU thread CLI option.
Added a configurable pinned base download directory.
Removed corpus records, logs, caches, environment folders and obsolete orchestration paths from public upload folders.
Preserved training core and data conversion sources; exact historical training needs separately restored frozen data.
evaluation_note: Recorded benchmark figures are inherited from the verified source archive; packaging validation does not constitute a fresh benchmark.
